```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
count(mallards, duck_id, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
summarise(
  mallards,
  min_latitude = min(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_latitude = max(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
  min_longitude = min(long, na.rm = TRUE),
  max_longitude = max(long, na.rm = TRUE)
)
```
